title: cystopteris fragilis
intro: Cystopteris fragilis, commonly known as the fragile fern or brittle fern, is a species of fern in the family Cystopteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with potential benefits including the treatment of respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cystopteris fragilis include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant activities, which contribute to its potential in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
